note: *Corromperam-se, e tornaram-se abomináveis* is 13:1b word for word. The stylist asked *fizeram-se*; refused for both twins at once (D44). Any change goes into Ps 13 too.

*como quem come pão* (13:4) held against both Latinist runs, who ask *como alimento de pão* for the noun phrase *ut cibum panis*; the agents call that not Portuguese. The stylist's *como se come o pão* is the other option.
*fizer voltar o cativeiro* replaced *reverter o cativeiro*, unknown to the blind reader. The stylist's sing-song remark on the rest of the line was refused because it is 13:7's wording (D44).
